title: Fix Dev Dashboard Rust Cli Package Name
description: Fix package ID specification repo_cli error when running script.ts in repo cli by updating package name to semio-framework-repo-cli.
summary: Updated Cargo package ID reference in `🧰️framework/🛍️product/🦑️repo/🔨️module/⌨️cli/⚡️implementation/🦀️rust/📜️script.ts` from `repo_cli` to `semio-framework-repo-cli` to match the crate name in `Cargo.toml`. Passed `devToolingEnv()` to `runCmd` and `runCmdStatus` for robust sccache/sandbox toolchain fallback. Verified cargo build and execution.
